verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt file at developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured markdown links to docs, and the entire developer docs site is markdown-accessible (.md suffixed pages like quickstart.md, webhooks.md, api-overview.md), making it directly consumable by an agent. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully consuming llms.txt in practice.
